Chemung County to host Medicare Open Enrollment event ELMIRA, N.Y. ( WETM ) – According to a release from the Chemung County Executive, the Department of Aging is set to host a Medicare Open Enrollment event on Tuesday.
 On Tuesday, Oct. 20, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., the Chemung County Department of Aging will host the event at the New Beginnings United Methodist Church located at 300 E Miller St. in Elmira.
 The event is walk-in, so no appointments or RSVP is required. It is open to all residents looking to review their current coverage, learn about plan options and prepare for possible changes in benefits and costs for the upcoming year.

 Because people's lives change from year to year, the release says Medicare plans should be reviewed and changed annually to ensure people have the coverage they need. The release says that local insurance agents and brokers will be available during the event to answer questions and talk about Medicare offers.
 All residents who take part in Medicare are encouraged to take advantage of the event to learn more about all that can be offered for them.
 Anyone looking for more information is asked to contact the Chemung County Department of Aging at 607-737-5520.
